title: InferenceSource
description: How a content relationship edge was derived. Canonical vocabulary for the inference_source field on relationship records. The DHT INFERENCE_SOURCES constant in content_store_integrity (lib.rs) is the Rust truth for the core 4 values; this schema agrees with it and adds 'system' (storage-layer derived, never notarized on-chain).

core.rationale: DHT-notarized: these four match the INFERENCE_SOURCES constant in content_store_integrity zome and are enforced by relationship integrity validation.

storage.rationale: Storage-layer derived edge; generated by the projection layer (e.g. prerequisite inference). Never written to the DHT directly.
